title: Reset a forgotten password
content: Use the Self-Service Password Portal at https://passwords.northstar.example. Choose Forgot password, enter your employee ID, and follow the verification link sent to your registered email. If locked out after verification, contact the service desk.

title: Unlock a locked account
content: Wait 15 minutes after repeated failed sign-ins, then unlock the account through the Self-Service Password Portal. If the account remains locked, contact the service desk with your employee ID. Never share your password.

title: Connect to the company VPN
content: Install Northstar Secure Connect from the company software portal. Sign in with your company account and approve the MFA prompt. Use the nearest regional gateway. Contact IT if the client reports a certificate or gateway error.

title: Set up multi-factor authentication
content: Register an authenticator app from the Security Settings page while connected to the company network. Scan the displayed QR code, confirm a one-time code, and save the recovery codes in an approved password manager.

title: Request a software license
content: Submit a Software Access request in the employee service portal. Include the product, business purpose, manager, and required date. Licensed software requires manager approval and may take up to three business days.

title: Install approved software
content: Install standard applications from the company software portal. For applications not listed there, submit a Software Access request. Do not download company software from unapproved sites.

title: Request a laptop or peripheral
content: Submit an Equipment request through the employee service portal and select your location and manager. Standard equipment is normally prepared before the start date; replacements require the existing device asset tag.

title: Connect to guest Wi-Fi
content: Select Northstar-Guest, accept the acceptable-use page, and enter the sponsor-provided access code. Guest access lasts one business day. Employees should use the secured Northstar-Corp network.

title: Configure email on a mobile device
content: Install the managed Company Mail app from the device app store. Sign in with your company email and complete MFA and device enrollment. The standard mail app is not supported for company data.

title: Report a phishing email
content: Use the Report Phishing button in Company Mail. Do not click links, reply, or forward the message. If you entered credentials, change your password from a trusted device and contact the service desk immediately.

title: Request shared-drive access
content: Submit a Shared Folder Access request with the folder path and business reason. The folder owner and manager must approve access. Access is reviewed periodically and removed when no longer needed.

title: Recover a deleted file
content: Check the cloud drive recycle bin first. Files remain recoverable there for 30 days. For older or shared-drive files, submit a Restore request with the file path, approximate deletion date, and owner.

title: Join a video meeting
content: Use the company-supported Meet app and sign in with your company account. Allow microphone and camera permissions. For connection issues, close other high-bandwidth apps and reconnect to the VPN only if the meeting requires internal resources.

title: Request a hardware repair
content: Create an IT Hardware ticket with the device asset tag, symptoms, when the problem began, and troubleshooting already attempted. Do not open or repair company equipment yourself.

title: Use the company password manager
content: Request access through the Security Tools catalog. Store work credentials only in the approved password manager, enable MFA, and never share vault credentials. Contact Security for access recovery.

title: Print from a company device
content: Connect to the Northstar-Corp network, add a printer from the managed device settings, and choose a listed office printer. Secure-print jobs require your badge at the printer. Remote employees can submit a print request to their office coordinator.

title: Report an outage
content: Check the internal service-status page for a known incident. If the affected service is not listed, report the service name, location, time started, and impact in an IT incident ticket. Critical outages should also be called into the service desk.

title: Request administrator privileges
content: Submit a Temporary Elevated Access request with the application, task, business reason, and duration. Manager and IT Security approval are required. Permanent local administrator access is not provided by default.

title: Replace a lost device
content: Immediately report a lost or stolen company device to the service desk and Security so they can disable access and remotely wipe it. Include the device type, asset tag if known, and last known location.

title: Back up work files
content: Save work files in the company-managed cloud drive, which backs up automatically. Local desktop and downloads folders are not guaranteed to be backed up. Do not store company files in personal cloud accounts.

title: Request annual leave
content: Submit annual leave in the HR portal before travel. Your manager approves requests based on team coverage. Check the portal for your individual balance; this knowledge base does not specify individual entitlements.

title: Report sick leave
content: Notify your manager as soon as practical and record sick leave in the HR portal when you are able. For an absence longer than three consecutive workdays, contact HR about required documentation and local rules.

title: Request a work-from-home arrangement
content: Discuss the proposed schedule with your manager and submit a Flexible Work request in the HR portal. Approval depends on role requirements, local policy, and team coverage. Keep your calendar and work location current.

title: Submit a business expense
content: Submit expenses in the Finance portal within 30 days. Attach an itemized receipt and business purpose, choose the correct cost center, and route the claim to your manager. Alcohol and personal expenses are not reimbursable.

title: Understand the performance review cycle
content: The company runs formal performance reviews twice each calendar year. Employees complete a self-review, managers provide feedback, and a discussion follows. HR publishes the exact dates and forms in the HR portal each cycle.

title: Report harassment or discrimination
content: You may report concerns to HR, your manager, or the confidential Ethics channel. Reports are handled as privately as possible and retaliation is prohibited. Contact emergency services if anyone is in immediate danger.

title: Request parental leave information
content: Contact HR through the Benefits and Leave case form for eligibility, duration, and pay details. Entitlements vary by work location and individual circumstances; HR will provide the applicable policy.

title: Update personal information
content: Update your address, phone, emergency contact, and legal name in the HR portal. Some changes require supporting documents. Contact HR if the portal does not allow the change you need.

title: Enroll in health benefits
content: New employees can enroll through the Benefits portal during their first 30 days. Existing employees may change elections during open enrollment or after a qualifying life event. Contact Benefits for plan and eligibility details.

title: Request an employment verification letter
content: Submit an Employment Verification request in the HR portal. Include the recipient, required information, and delivery method. Allow five business days for processing.

title: Understand the code of conduct
content: Employees are expected to act honestly, protect confidential information, disclose conflicts of interest, and treat colleagues respectfully. Read the complete Code of Conduct in the HR portal and ask HR or Ethics about specific situations.

title: Request an accommodation
content: Contact HR through the confidential Accommodation request form. Share the workplace change you need and the best way to reach you. HR will discuss the interactive process and any documentation required under local law.

title: Find learning and development resources
content: Browse the Learning Hub for approved courses and role-based pathways. For reimbursement or paid training time, agree on the plan with your manager before enrolling.

title: Refer a candidate
content: Submit referrals through the Careers portal before the candidate applies. Include the candidate's consent and the role. Referral awards, when available, are subject to the current program rules in the portal.

title: Resolve a workplace conflict
content: If comfortable, speak respectfully with the person involved. You may also ask your manager or HR for support. For harassment, discrimination, safety, or retaliation concerns, use a formal reporting channel instead.

title: Request a leave balance statement
content: View your current leave balances in the HR portal under Time Off. Balances reflect approved and recorded leave and may take one business day to update. Contact HR if a balance appears incorrect.

title: Understand probation and onboarding
content: Your manager reviews role goals during onboarding and schedules a probation check-in according to your offer and local policy. Contact HR for the applicable probation period; it varies by contract and location.

title: Access the employee assistance program
content: The confidential Employee Assistance Program provides counseling and referrals. Find current contact details in the Benefits portal. The program is separate from performance management and does not share session details with managers.

title: Request a workplace transfer
content: Discuss the target role with your manager and apply through the internal Careers portal. Transfers require the hiring manager's selection and HR approval. Review eligibility and notice rules in the internal mobility policy.

title: Ask about a payroll discrepancy
content: Open a Payroll case in the HR portal. Include the pay period, a description of the discrepancy, and relevant earning or deduction labels. Do not include full bank details or government ID numbers in the case description.

title: Find the payday schedule
content: Payroll dates are listed in the Payroll calendar in the HR portal. Bank posting times can vary by financial institution. Contact Payroll if pay is still missing one business day after the published pay date.

title: Submit tax declarations
content: Submit tax declarations and supporting documents through the secure Payroll portal by the published annual deadline. Do not email tax documents or sensitive identity numbers. Contact Payroll for jurisdiction-specific questions.

title: Update direct deposit details
content: Update bank details in the secure Payroll portal and verify the change using MFA. Changes received after the payroll cutoff may take effect in the next pay cycle. Payroll will never ask you to send bank credentials by email.

title: Read a payslip
content: Payslips are available in the secure Payroll portal. They list gross pay, deductions, taxes, and net pay for the period. Contact Payroll with the pay date and line-item label if you need an explanation.

title: Ask about compensation bands
content: Your manager and HR Business Partner can explain the compensation framework that applies to your role. Individual compensation details are confidential and are not available through this general help desk.

title: Prepare for the first day
content: Check your welcome email for start time, location, and identity documents to bring. Your manager or onboarding coordinator will share the first-day schedule. Contact HR if you have not received the welcome email two business days before starting.

title: Receive a new employee laptop
content: IT prepares standard equipment before the start date when onboarding details arrive on time. Your manager or onboarding coordinator confirms delivery or pickup. Contact the service desk if your device is missing on your first workday.

title: Meet an onboarding buddy
content: New employees are normally matched with an onboarding buddy during their first week. Ask your manager or onboarding coordinator if you have not received an introduction by the end of that week.

title: Complete onboarding tasks
content: Use the onboarding checklist in the HR portal to complete personal details, policy acknowledgments, benefits enrollment, and required training. The portal shows due dates and completion status.
